recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: developers walking away from walled app stores
a month lived deliberately without machine assistance
AI laptop branding quietly vanishing from shelves
crowds gathering along the Seine for an open-air Mass
maritime corridors holding breath near narrow straits
autumn fog rolling over San Francisco at eleven degrees

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Sketch shipping lanes through pre-dawn fog before sunrise hits the bay — each drag-route must reach a dock without crossing your own previous paths.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one clean route threading every pier before the sky turns gold
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: more docks spawn, fog thickens, crossing lines snap and reset
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor sunrise over a muted SF bay

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Swipe falling AI-assistant badges left into recycle or right onto a shelf before the Copilot+ branding collapses — fakes look almost identical to keepers.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a single cascade clearing the entire shelf in one motion
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: badges tumble faster, decoys multiply, shelf tilts

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Tap in rhythm to chain phone shortcuts into a living agent workflow — each beat fires the next node; miss a beat and the whole pipeline stalls mid-ship.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: nailing three linked agents in one unbroken groove
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: polyrhythms stack, nodes overlap, tempo drifts upward

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick autumn leaves off a bridge railing to land in pilgrim silhouettes below — gargoyles and wind gusts punish sloppy arcs.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: watching one leaf trace a perfect parabola into the crowd
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind shifts mid-air, targets shrink, stone gargoyles block lanes
